_about: XMLTV → HermesTV channel ID map. See docs/44_EPG_XMLTV_SETUP.md.
_keys: Keys are the channel IDs your XMLTV feed emits (the <channel id="..."> attribute, also the programme @channel attribute). Operators discover them via the X-Hermes-XMLTV-Channels response header on /api/epg, or by curl-piping the feed and grepping `<channel id`.
_values: Values are HermesTV catalog channel IDs in the slug form (live.<slug>), where <slug> comes from services/hermes-tv-api/src/data/seedCatalog.js LIVE_DEFS. The same form is used by routes/channels.js and routes/catchup.js, so EPG and live-tile playback share one ID space.
_additive: This file is ADDITIVE. Operators extend `map` as they wire real channels. Channels absent from the map are dropped from /api/epg responses (no orphan tiles).
